answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zenith of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the signal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the spiral of the next round. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
